# Develocity Documentation

> Official documentation for Develocity, Gradle's enterprise developer productivity platform. Covers installation, administration, Build Scan, Build Cache, Predictive Test Selection, Test Distribution, and all build tool integrations.

Develocity documentation is published at https://docs.gradle.com/develocity/current/

## What Develocity Provides

Develocity is an enterprise developer productivity platform that helps teams:

- Accelerate builds with Build Cache and Test Distribution
- Debug build and test failures with Build Scan
- Monitor build performance and trends
- Optimize CI/CD pipeline efficiency

## Key Concepts

- Build Scan: a shareable build record with performance data and diagnostics
- Build Cache: shared cache of build outputs to avoid repeating work
- Test Distribution: run tests across multiple agents to reduce overall test time
- Predictive test selection: machine learning-based test selection to reduce test execution time

- [Full page index](https://docs.gradle.com/develocity/llms-index.txt)

## Develocity Platform (2026.2)

- [Quickstart](https://docs.gradle.com/develocity/2026.2/quickstart/index.md): get started with Develocity by creating a Build Scan or deploying on AWS EC2
- [Installation](https://docs.gradle.com/develocity/2026.2/installation/index.md): choose an installation path based on your infrastructure and scaling needs
- [Administration](https://docs.gradle.com/develocity/2026.2/administration/index.md): install, configure, upgrade, and operate Develocity
- [Using Develocity](https://docs.gradle.com/develocity/2026.2/using-develocity/index.md): Build Scan, Build Cache, Predictive Test Selection, and Test Distribution
- [Guides](https://docs.gradle.com/develocity/2026.2/guides/index.md): in-depth guides for flaky test detection, failure classification, and test intelligence
- [Integrations](https://docs.gradle.com/develocity/2026.2/integrations/index.md): AI-assisted build analysis, ephemeral CI acceleration, supply chain governance, and IDE integration
- [Operations](https://docs.gradle.com/develocity/2026.2/operations/index.md): upgrading, maintaining, troubleshooting, and recovering your Develocity instance
- [Reference](https://docs.gradle.com/develocity/2026.2/reference/index.md): API manuals, Helm chart references, export API, and event model schema
- [Version and Release Reference](https://docs.gradle.com/develocity/2026.2/miscellaneous/index.md): compatibility tables, support lifecycle, release notes, security advisories, and glossary

## Build Tool Integrations

- [Develocity for Gradle](https://docs.gradle.com/develocity/gradle/4.5/index.md): enable Build Scan, caching, and performance reporting for Gradle builds (4.5)
- [Develocity for Maven](https://docs.gradle.com/develocity/maven/2.5/index.md): enable Build Scan and build insights for Maven projects (2.5)
- [Develocity for sbt](https://docs.gradle.com/develocity/sbt/1.4/index.md): integrate sbt builds with Develocity (1.4)
- [Develocity for Bazel](https://docs.gradle.com/develocity/bazel/index.md): capture build information from Bazel
- [Develocity for npm](https://docs.gradle.com/develocity/npm/4.1/index.md): capture build and test information for Node.js projects (4.1)
- [Develocity for Python](https://docs.gradle.com/develocity/python/0.10/index.md): capture build and test information for Python projects (0.10)

## Build Acceleration and Compliance

- [Develocity Test Distribution](https://docs.gradle.com/develocity/test-distribution/3.8/index.md): distributed test execution to reduce overall test time (3.8)
- [Develocity Edge](https://docs.gradle.com/develocity/edge/2.2/index.md): edge nodes for geographically distributed deployments (2.2)
- [Develocity Artifact Cache CLI](https://docs.gradle.com/develocity/artifact-cache/1.4/index.md): cache external dependencies and tools to reduce network downloads (1.4)
- [Develocity Build Cache Node](https://docs.gradle.com/develocity/bcn/21.2/index.md): standalone Build Cache instances for distributed teams (21.2)
- [Develocity Provenance Governor](https://docs.gradle.com/develocity/provenance-governor/1.9/index.md): supply chain governance and compliance automation (1.9)

## Reporting and Analytics

- [Develocity Reporting Kit](https://docs.gradle.com/develocity/reporting-kit/2.3/index.md): data access and visualization for build analytics (2.3)
- [Develocity Reporting via Amazon Athena](https://docs.gradle.com/develocity/reporting-aws/2.1/index.md): Grafana dashboards for build metrics on AWS (2.1)

## Developer Tooling

- [Develocity IntelliJ Plugin](https://docs.gradle.com/develocity/intellij-plugin/1.3/index.md): IDE integration for Build Scans and failure analysis (1.3)

## Develocity Support

- [Develocity CLI](https://docs.gradle.com/develocity/develocityctl/1.23/index.md): command-line administration tool for Develocity (1.23)
